reviews.content:
the mod is great but misses some tweaks:
- brightness  control is not functionable 
- wifi name & icon should be displayed instead of ethernet
- for all panels , add display on hover and minimize with duration on mouse unfocus
- add expand on hover option for system tray icons, it would be much easier 
- make island elements & system tray icons draggable, so their position/order can be changed, 
- drag tray icon can be dragged outside the tray icon list and drop next island main element (eg: next to wifi/sound icon....)
- add battery percentage
- for style: system accent color, glassmorphism, blurry background
- adjust icon size for sound and battery icon; they looks too smaller than the others
i preciate your work.
This is insane. hope it gets better with future updates. like windhawk blur support.
